name: NOX AETERNA - Veil of Darkness
source:
A story of a naive yet curious teenager who, with the support of his friends, delves into the mystery of a classmate's hospitalization under unexplained circumstances.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
讲述了一个天真而又好奇的少年在朋友的支持下，深入探究同学不明原因住院的谜团。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436630/]Steam[/url]]
